posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow again, coach Dan Quinn confirmed, adding that an X-ray didn’t show a fracture.

More tests to come Monday, but Daniels will be out for some time: “We’ll rally around Marcus (Mariota).”

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Jets WR Omar Cooper Jr. is believed to have suffered a high ankle sprain in today’s win over Tennessee, sources say. 

X-rays were negative. Cooper, the first-round pick, will have an MRI on Monday to determine the extent of the injury.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Myles Garrett is now set to miss games against the Giants, Broncos, Eagles and Bills. L.A. hosts the Cardinals in Week 6.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Rams star Myles Garrett will undergo arthroscopic surgery on his ailing knee and is headed to injured reserve, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Garrett has been dealing with lower-leg pain and wasn’t himself in Thursday’s opener. The hope is he’s back in four weeks.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald says the team got good news on Sam Darnold, who underwent tests that ruled out a hip fracture. Still more tests to come. But Macdonald sounded upbeat about the initial prognosis.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Baker Mayfield’s new contract with the Bucs got him to the $55 million benchmark he wanted. It also prevented a scenario where Tampa Bay would have to carry a nonnegotiable cap number of nearly $80 million for its QB next season.

More in The Sweep: tompelissero.substack.com/p/week-1-not...

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Drake Maye wasn’t the only QB hurting in the Super Bowl. Sam Darnold spent most of the playoffs in a rehab progression for an external oblique strain as the Seahawks made a championship run.

More ahead of tonight’s rematch in a free column at The Sweep: tompelissero.substack.com/p/week-1-not...

Former #Bucs OC Byron Leftwich is back in coaching as he is joining Deion Sanders’ staff at Colorado.

Leftwich interviewed for multiple NFL jobs this past cycle (Pats HC, Seahawks OC) but now makes the move to college.
